```php title="PHP"

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<blockquote><ul><li>item a<ul><li>sub a1</li></ul></li></ul></blockquote>");
```
